pe.note: Company has a history of net losses (Q1 2025 revenue -28.1% YoY with widening losses); H1 2026 preliminary release claims a small positive net result but figures conflict (see conflicts). Trailing EPS not reliably establishable; no analyst forward estimates found.

growth.source: GlobeNewswire/sustainabilitymag: 'Turbo Energy Reports Record Preliminary First Half 2026 Results with 180% Revenue Growth and Positive Operating Income' (2026-07-27)

catalysts.headline: Announced a portfolio of 15 firm-order commercial & industrial (C&I) energy-storage projects across Spain and Chile, 15.6 MWh / 5.95 MW, estimated order value ~EUR3M (~US$3.48-3.5M) attributable to Turbo Energy
Announced a roughly $3.5M (EUR 3M) portfolio of 15 firm-order commercial and industrial energy-storage projects (15.6 MWh) across Spain and Chile
catalysts.impact: stock up about 80% on thin volume

catalysts.headline: Preliminary H1 2026 results: record revenue, +180% YoY, positive operating income; shareholders' equity rose to ~EUR5.52M (from ~EUR1.60M at YE2025) largely on ~EUR3.78M raised via registered direct offering + ATM program
Nasdaq confirmed Turbo Energy regained compliance with the minimum stockholders'-equity requirement (Listing Rule 5550(b)(1)) after the capital raise lifted equity from ~$1.88M to ~$6.48M
catalysts.source: News summary (briefglance.com 'Turbo Energy Regains Nasdaq Compliance After $5M Capital Raise')

catalysts.headline: "Turbo Energy Advances Nasdaq Compliance and Expands Global Energy Storage Footprint"
